info.description: Uses the last recorded balances as starting values on evaluatedOn. USD integer cents. Constant net wealth change uses actual days / 365. Net change includes all gains, losses, income and spending. Liquidity uses constant household and business burn, reviewed debt payment treatments, no future inflows or private exits. An immediate outflow is a liquidity stress only. A missing measure is null.

post.summary: Compare dated net-worth targets and test a reserve through a date without saving
post.description: Uses the last recorded balances as starting values on evaluatedOn. USD integer cents. Constant net wealth change uses actual days / 365. Net change includes all gains, losses, income and spending. Liquidity uses constant household and business burn, reviewed debt payment treatments, no future inflows or private exits. An immediate outflow is a liquidity stress only. A missing measure is null. Supply annualNetWorthChangeMinor to model a dated result. requiredAnnualNetIncreaseMinor is a break-even rate of change, not an expected return. Only set assumeNoDebt if the owner explicitly authorizes that scenario assumption.

get.summary: Inspect values in one accepted baseline, subsequent provider observations, reviewed marks and public evidence
get.description: A source capture date is distinct from a mark date. Public signals are company observations. Membership and baseline values are immutable. Later evidence is current at each page read. Prices use millionths of USD per share. Email coverage is unavailable.
